info.title: Income Tax Calculation and Reporting API
info.description: Computes tax due and quarterly reporting figures from income, deductions and jurisdiction. Pre-launch design; endpoints are not live yet.

servers.description: Pre-launch: endpoints are not live yet and answer 503.

post.description: Returns computed tax due and quarterly reporting figures for an individual or business based on the supplied income, deductions and jurisdiction.

requestBody.description: The income and jurisdiction details to calculate tax on.

jurisdiction.description: The tax jurisdiction and filing regime, for example US-FEDERAL.

filing_status.description: Filing status for an individual, for example single or married-filing-jointly.

gross_income.description: Gross income in the reporting currency.

deductions.description: Claimed deductions to subtract before tax is computed.

tax_year.description: The tax year the calculation applies to.

400.description: Missing or invalid income, deductions or jurisdiction.

503.description: Pre-launch: endpoints are not live yet.
